identification_strategy: One-line: IV — treatment = equity dependence, control = non-equity dependence; shock/instrument/cutoff = KZ index

key_variables.treatment: Equity dependence based on KZ index

conclusion_detail: Firms with high equity dependence have investment that is almost three times as sensitive to stock prices as firms with low equity dependence.
main_effect: Investment sensitivity is almost three times larger for high KZ index firms compared to low KZ index firms.
key_robustness: Use of KZ index as a proxy
notes: The exact sample period is not specified, and the reliance on the KZ index as a proxy may introduce some measurement error.
